$comment: The source of sf-spinner's element plumbing (core/js/element-manifest.js). Taken from simai/ui-control control/smart-architecture/migration/out/spinner (migration/convert-1.3.8.mjs over simai/ui-source@5100227); standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8, vocabulary 1.1.5. Every x-todo of the conversion is decided: x-decisions says how.

refresh-spinner.x-summary: Draws the spinner again from its settings (after the page changed data-sf-spinner around it)

default.$comment: The Lit template in JavaScript, the migration form of §5.2 (§16).

accessibility.$comment: role status (a polite, atomic live region) only while announce is on and the label is not empty; otherwise the drawing is aria-hidden and has no role. It takes no focus.

x-summary: Indeterminate waiting indicator in one of four looks on the size ladder (arc, breathing, comet, dots), following the page's data-sf-spinner, with optional polite status announcement and Framework-owned motion.
x-renamed: settings.dots: type string with the numeral default "8" → number (§16 item 29)
settings.filled: type string with the numeral default "3" → number (§16 item 29)
lang runtime also holds the words of SPINNER_TEXT (ui-source/src/component/spinner/js/_spinner.js): a shared script this component draws with (§11: no word lives only inside a bundle)
settings.variant: the kind axis's old name, a dated setting alias of kind
settings.width, height, stroke-width, dot-radius: the pixel geometry deprecated since 1.1.0 (journal attribute-spinner-pixel-geometry) leaves the interface; still drawn and noted until 2026-12-01
methods.getSpinnerRoot: a reader retires (§4.4), kept and noted until the date

forbidden_client_responsibilities: setting or clearing aria-busy on the containing region
inventing completion, error or timeout messages

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-spinner for a bounded waiting state whose progress cannot be expressed as a meaningful percentage.
do_not: Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not move host data or access decisions into the component
Do not use Spinner when determinate Progress or content-matched Skeleton is more accurate
Do not omit the containing region's aria-busy state
Do not announce an empty or non-localized label
Do not give every spinner its own kind to restyle a page: set data-sf-spinner on html (or a block) and every spinner the Framework draws follows it

x-decisions: version: 1.1.0 → 1.2.0: variant is a dated alias, the pixel geometry and getSpinnerRoot retire behind dated rows, dots and filled are numbers; a minor while the rows hold (§4.10).

a11y-role: one role, status, written with when {announce: true}: the root is a polite atomic live region only while announce is on and the label is not empty; otherwise it is aria-hidden and has no role. The name is the label (an empty label is a spinner with no words, as the table's).

existing-aliases: compatibility.deprecations (width, height, stroke-width, dot-radius → size) fold into aliases.json as retired attribute rows with the dates; the shared class spinner still reads and notes them until the sweep, and the element observes them.
number-type: dots and filled are integers (§16 item 29); the shared drawing clamps them.
refresh-spinner: kept, the element's own redraw (it is not the vocabulary's refresh, which re-reads data); it answers applied.
template: templates.default names the Lit template js/templates/default.js, the migration form §5.2 allows.
examples: examples.json from studio.fixture.json plus the looks, an announced spinner and one with no words; probe.json drives the role, the name and the aliases.
skeleton: none; the spinner is itself what stands in while something loads, with no port and no late data (§5.4).
css-variables: six public variables read by the class sheet with the role token as fallback (src/core/contracts/public-variables.v1.json).

version 1.2.1: the bundle carries no element layer of its own -- element-manifest, aliases, the alias table, the host port, deprecations, page actions, the layer stack, the open-surface mark and the instance path come from the page's shared runtime (SF.runtimeModule, runtime ABI 1, core.runtime 1.1.0), one instance per page -- and embeds of this file only the keys the runtime reads. Behaviour unchanged.
